title: WinB root "Engram Runner (Codex)" session-9 is listed on Central but a native send to it returns 404; Engram's WinB cleanup is blocked on it
outcome: WinB root "Engram Runner (Codex)" session-9 is listed on Central but a native send to it returns 404; Engram's WinB cleanup is blocked on it
acceptance: The cause of the 404 for a native send to host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-9 while Central's session listing shows that session is identified with evidence (stale listing, wrong route, membership, or relay defect) and recorded here.

A native send from Central to the WinB Engram Runner (Codex) root is delivered and woken, shown by its receipt and the recipient's processed sequence, or a supported equivalent route to a Codex executor on WinB is in place and recorded.
If the cause is a product defect, it is fixed with a behaviour test, or filed as its own item with provenance (w-386def05f4a2).
